SELECT p.id, p.image, p.store_name, p.store_info, p.price, p.ot_price AS original_price, (IFNULL(p.sales, 0) + IFNULL(p.ficti, 0)) AS sales, p.stock, p.is_show, e.flower_materials, e.flower_language, e.occasion, e.recipient, e.color_series FROM eb_store_product p INNER JOIN eb_flower_product_ext e ON e.product_id = p.id WHERE p.is_show = 1 AND p.is_del = 0 AND p.is_recycle = 0
AND p.store_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.keyword}, '%')
AND FIND_IN_SET(#{request.occasion}, e.occasion)
AND FIND_IN_SET(#{request.recipient}, e.recipient)
AND FIND_IN_SET(#{request.colorSeries}, e.color_series)
AND p.price >= #{request.minPrice}
AND p.price <= #{request.maxPrice}
ORDER BY p.sort DESC, p.id DESC
